Algebra I · Lesson 6.3

Percents

Solve this lesson →All lessons

What an amount is compared against is called the base, the number a percent is taken of. Twelve percent of one base and twelve percent of another are different amounts, so a percent alone leaves the amount unknown. Prealgebra chapter 9 did the arithmetic. New here is naming an unknown with a letter, which turns a percent sentence into an equation.

Problem
A quality check clears 64%64% of a shipment. Percent means per hundred, so 64%64% is the ratio 6410010064​. Reduce it to lowest terms and enter the fraction.
Show a hint
  • Both parts of a ratio can be divided by the same number without changing it, and 6464 and 100100 share a factor larger than 22.
  • That factor is 44, so divide above and below the bar by 44, then check whether the result reduces again.
Show the full solution
Dividing both parts by 44 gives 64100=162510064​=2516​​. Since 1616 and 2525 share no common factor above 11, that is lowest terms. As a decimal it is 64÷100=0.6464÷100=0.64, the same number with the point moved two places left.
Problem
A sensor logs 720207​ of its readings as out of range. A percent is a ratio whose second part is 100100, so rewrite 720207​ with 100100 below the bar. Enter the percent, just the number.
Show a hint
  • Multiplying both parts of a ratio by the same number leaves it unchanged, so find the factor that turns the 2020 below the bar into 100100.
  • 20×5=10020×5=100, so multiply above the bar by 55 as well.
Show the full solution
Multiplying both parts by 55 gives 720=35100207​=10035​, so the percent is 3535​. A second route gives the same number, 720×100=35207​×100=35, and it still works when the denominator does not divide 100100.
Key idea
A percent is a ratio whose second part is 100100. The symbol %% means per hundred, so p%p% is the ratio p:100p:100, the number p100100p​. Everything 6.1 established about ratios holds here unchanged, so multiplying both parts by the same number leaves the value alone, and 720207​ and 3510010035​ are one number written twice. With the second part fixed at 100100 for every percent, comparing two percents is comparing their first parts and nothing else.
Problem
A label states that a bottle of saline is 6.5%6.5% salt by mass, so the ratio of salt to total mass is 6.51001006.5​. Lowest terms means the top and the bottom are whole numbers with no common factor other than 11. Enter 6.5%6.5% as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show a hint
  • Multiplying the top and the bottom by the same number does not change the value, and multiplying by 1010 removes the decimal point.
  • That gives 651000100065​, and 6565 and 10001000 share a factor of 55.
Show the full solution
Multiplying the top and the bottom by 1010 gives 6.5100=6510001006.5​=100065​, and dividing both by 55 gives 1320020013​​. Since 1313 is prime and does not divide 200200, that is lowest terms. As a decimal it is 0.0650.065.
Problem
A machinist finds that 5665​ of a batch passes inspection. That fraction is already in lowest terms and no whole number times 66 gives 100100, so it cannot be rescaled to a whole number over 100100. Multiply 5665​ by 100100 anyway and enter the exact percent as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show a hint
  • Rescaling is blocked here, so the route left is plain arithmetic. Multiplying 5665​ by 100100 multiplies the numerator by 100100 and leaves the 66 underneath alone.
  • 56×100=500665​×100=6500​, and 500500 and 66 are both even.
Show the full solution
56×100=500665​×100=6500​, and dividing the numerator and the denominator by 22 gives 25033250​​. The same percent is often written 8313%8331​%. Long division gives 250÷3=83.333…250÷3=83.333…, which never terminates, so 83.3%83.3% and 83.33%83.33% are roundings while 2503%3250​% is exact.
Key idea
Percent, fraction and decimal. Percent to fraction, write p100100p​, clear any decimal above the bar by multiplying both parts by 1010, then reduce. Percent to decimal, divide by 100100, which moves the point two places left. Fraction or decimal to percent, multiply by 100100, since x=100x100x=100100x​ and the first part of that ratio is the percent. When a fraction in lowest terms has a denominator with a prime factor other than 22 or 55, its decimal repeats, so the exact percent is a fraction such as 25033250​ and every decimal form of it is a rounding.

A percent question names three numbers, an amount, a percent, and the whole the percent is taken of. The sentence aa is p%p% of bb says aa equals p100100p​ of bb, and of means multiply, so the sentence is a=p100ba=100p​b. Two of the three are given and one is the letter. The next two problems leave out a different one.

Problem
A vineyard has 875 vines and 24%24% of them are a new cultivar. Here p=24p=24 and b=875b=875, and the amount aa is missing. Substitute into a=p100ba=100p​b and enter the number of new-cultivar vines.
Show a hint
  • 24%24% is the number 2410010024​, and of means multiply, so the count is 2410010024​ times 875875.
  • 2410010024​ reduces to 625256​, and 875÷25=35875÷25=35, so divide before multiplying.
Show the full solution
a=24100(875)=625(875)=6(35)=210a=10024​(875)=256​(875)=6(35)=210​. Reducing 2410010024​ first turns the work into 875÷25875÷25 and 6×356×35, shorter than multiplying 875875 by 2424 and then dividing by 100100.
Problem
A hall has 650 seats and 273 of them are booked. This time a=273a=273 and b=650b=650 are known and pp is missing. Solve a=p100ba=100p​b for pp and enter the percent of the seats booked, just the number.
Show a hint
  • Substituting gives 273=p100(650)273=100p​(650), and multiplying both sides by 100100 clears the fraction.
  • That leaves 650p=27300650p=27300, a one-letter equation of the kind 4.2 solves in one division.
Show the full solution
From 273=p100(650)273=100p​(650), multiplying both sides by 100100 gives 650p=27300650p=27300, so p=42p=42​. Dividing part by whole gives the same number, since 273650=0.42650273​=0.42 and 0.42×100=420.42×100=42.
Key idea
The percent equation, a=p100ba=100p​b. The sentence aa is p%p% of bb is that equation, with bb the base, aa the amount compared against it, and pp the percent. Any two of the three are enough to find the third. With pp and bb given, multiply. With aa and bb given, p=100abp=b100a​. With aa and pp given, b=100apb=p100a​. Each rearrangement is chapter 4 work on a one-letter linear equation, so there is one equation here and not three separate rules.

The third case goes wrong most often. In a=p100ba=100p​b the base is the quantity being multiplied, so when the base is what is missing the equation has to be undone rather than run forward. The next two problems are both of that kind, and each one names the number the wrong route produces.

Problem
At a theatre, 350 seats are sold, and that is 28%28% of the seats in the house. A student computes 28%28% of 350350 and reports a house of 9898 seats. Enter the correct number of seats in the house.
Show a hint
  • The 28%28% is taken of the whole house, so the house is the whole bb and the 350350 is the amount aa.
  • 350=28100b350=10028​b, and multiplying both sides by 100100 gives 35000=28b35000=28b.
Show the full solution
From 350=28100b350=10028​b, multiplying both sides by 100100 gives 28b=3500028b=35000, so b=1250b=1250​. Since 350350 is the part rather than the whole, the correct move is to divide by 2810010028​ instead of multiplying, and 9898 is smaller than the 350350 seats already sold.
Fun fact
Augustus levied the centesima rerum venalium, a hundredth on the price of goods sold at auction, to fund army pensions. Roman clerks were computing in hundredths for centuries before there was a percent sign.
Problem
An inspector passes 62%62% of a shipment and sets the other 209 items aside. The 209 is not the 62%62% part, so work out what percent of the shipment it is before writing the equation. Enter the number of items in the shipment.
Show a hint
  • The whole shipment is 100%100% of itself, and the set-aside items are what is left once the passing 62%62% is taken out.
  • The set-aside items are 38%38%, so the equation is 209=38100b209=10038​b.
Show the full solution
The set-aside items are 100−62=38100−62=38 percent of the shipment, so 209=38100b209=10038​b gives 38b=2090038b=20900 and b=550b=550​. Dividing 209209 by 0.620.62 instead pairs the count with the wrong percent and gives about 337337. The check is 62100(550)=34110062​(550)=341, the number that passed, and 341+209=550341+209=550.
Key idea
Finding the base is a division. In a=p100ba=100p​b the base is multiplied by p100100p​, so multiplying both sides by 100pp100​ leaves b=100apb=p100a​. Multiplying the part by the percent instead computes p100a100p​a, the answer to a different question, what p%p% of the part is. For pp below 100100 that product is smaller than aa, and a base is never smaller than a part of itself, so the size alone is enough to reject it. The check is one multiplication, since p100100p​ of the answer has to come to aa.

The same amount is a different percent of different bases, and one percent taken against different bases gives different amounts. Fifteen percent of 200200 is 3030, and fifteen percent of 800800 is 120120. When a story states two totals, each percent belongs to the total its own sentence names, and adding the two gives a percent of neither.

Problem
A cannery runs two filling lines. The morning line fills 720 tins and 45%45% of them hold soup. The afternoon line fills 450 tins and 16%16% of them hold soup. Each percent is taken of its own line's run. Enter the total number of tins of soup.
Show a hint
  • The 45%45% is taken of the morning run only and the 16%16% of the afternoon run only, so the two bases are different and the counts have to be worked out separately.
  • The morning count is 45100(720)10045​(720), and the afternoon count is the same form with 1616 as the percent and 450450 as the base.
Show the full solution
The morning count is 45100(720)=32410045​(720)=324 and the afternoon count is 16100(450)=7210016​(450)=72, so the total is 324+72=396324+72=396​. Adding the percents and taking 61%61% of all 11701170 tins gives 713.7713.7, which is wrong because neither percent was measured against 11701170.
Problem
A car park holds only vans and cars, 96 vans and 384 cars. Enter the percent of all the vehicles in the car park that are vans, just the number.
Show a hint
  • The comparison is against every vehicle in the car park, and that total is not printed in the problem.
  • The whole is 96+384=48096+384=480, so the equation is 96=p100(480)96=100p​(480).
Show the full solution
The car park holds 96+384=48096+384=480 vehicles, so 96=p100(480)96=100p​(480) gives 480p=9600480p=9600 and p=20p=20​. Taking 384384 as the whole instead gives 2525, which is 6.1's part-to-part comparison rather than a share of every vehicle.
Key idea
The base is what follows the word of. In aa is p%p% of bb, the quantity named after of is bb, and bb is the quantity p100100p​ is multiplied by. Swapping the two changes the answer, since 100abb100a​ and 100baa100b​ are equal only when a=ba=b. When a story gives two parts and no total, the base for a share of the whole is their sum and not the other part. When it gives two totals, each percent has its own base, so one percent of the combined total is a different quantity from either.

The equation a=p100ba=100p​b holds for any pp, not only for pp between 11 and 100100. With pp above 100100, p100100p​ is greater than 11, so the amount comes out larger than the base. With pp below 11, p100100p​ is smaller than 11001001​, so the base is more than a hundred times the amount.

Problem
Depot A holds 2380 tonnes of grain, which is 175%175% of what Depot B holds. Here 175100100175​ is greater than 11. Enter the number of tonnes Depot B holds.
Show a hint
  • The 2380 tonnes is compared against what Depot B holds, so Depot B is the base. Call that base bb.
  • 2380=175100b2380=100175​b, and 175100100175​ reduces to 7447​.
Show the full solution
Depot B is the base, so 2380=175100b=74b2380=100175​b=47​b. Multiplying both sides by 44 gives 7b=95207b=9520, so b=1360b=1360​. With a percent above 100100 the amount is larger than the base, so any answer above 2380 would be wrong.
Problem
A quarry's tailings are 0.15%0.15% recoverable metal by mass, and that metal weighs 42 tonnes. Of those same tailings, 5040 tonnes have already been shipped to a second site. Enter what percent of the total tailings mass has been shipped, just the number.
Show a hint
  • 0.15%0.15% is 0.151001000.15​, which is 0.00150.0015, and the metal is that fraction of all the tailings, so the tailings mass is a missing base.
  • Multiplying 42=0.15100b42=1000.15​b by 100100 gives 0.15b=42000.15b=4200, so bb comes out by dividing by 0.150.15. With bb known, solve 5040=p100b5040=100p​b for pp.
Show the full solution
From 42=0.15100b42=1000.15​b, multiplying both sides by 100100 gives 0.15b=42000.15b=4200, so b=28000b=28000 tonnes, and then 5040=p100(28000)5040=100p​(28000) gives 28000p=50400028000p=504000 and p=18p=18​. Since the percent is below 11, the base is more than a hundred times the amount, which is why 42 tonnes of metal comes from 28000 tonnes of tailings.

Every question here was a=p100ba=100p​b with a different one of the three letters unknown, and the work each time was deciding which number is the base. Lesson 6.4, Percent Problems, keeps that equation and takes up the case where a quantity rises or falls by a percent, and the base there is what the quantity was before the change.

Practice these ideas

Practice
Write 85%85% as a fraction in lowest terms.
Show the solution
Dividing numerator and denominator of 8510010085​ by 55 gives 17202017​​. Since 1717 is prime and 2020 is not a multiple of 1717, no further reducing is possible.
Practice
Write 9%9% as a decimal.
Show the solution
9%9% is 91001009​, so move the decimal point in 9.09.0 two places left to divide by 100100, which gives 9%=0.099%=0.09​. One place left would give 0.90.9, and that is 90%90%.
Practice
A pressure gauge reads 0.580.58 of full scale. Enter that reading as a percent, just the number.
Show the solution
Multiplying by 100100 gives 0.58×100=580.58×100=58​. Two decimal places means hundredths, so 0.58=581000.58=10058​, which is 5858 per hundred.
Practice
A crate is 13252513​ full. Rewrite that ratio with 100100 below the bar and enter the percent, just the number.
Show the solution
Multiplying both parts by 44 gives 1325=521002513​=10052​, so the percent is 5252​.
Practice
A battery loses 2.4%2.4% of its charge overnight. Write 2.4%2.4% as a decimal.
Show the solution
Dividing by 100100 slides the decimal point two places to the left, so 2.4%=2.4100=0.0242.4%=1002.4​=0.024​. One hop left of 2.42.4 gives 0.240.24, and 0.240.24 is 24%24%, so the second hop is the one that matters.
Practice
A service fee is 7.5%7.5% of an order. Write 7.5%7.5% as a fraction in lowest terms, in the form a/ba/b.
Show the solution
Multiplying top and bottom of 7.51001007.5​ by 1010 gives 751000100075​, and dividing both by 2525 gives 340403​​. Multiplying top and bottom by the same number never changes the value, so 7.51001007.5​ and 340403​ are the same number.
Practice
A kiln fires 4994​ of a load at a time. Since 99 does not divide 100100, that share is not a whole number of percent. Enter it as an exact percent, written as a single fraction in lowest terms rather than a mixed number or a rounded decimal.
Show the solution
A percent is a count of hundredths, so the number of percent is 49×100=400994​×100=9400​​. The numerator 400400 and the denominator 99 have no common factor other than 11, so that is lowest terms, and the decimal form 44.444…44.444… does not terminate, which makes 44.4%44.4% a rounding and not the exact share.
Practice
A depot stores 840 tyres and 65%65% of them are winter tyres. Enter the number of winter tyres.
Show the solution
a=65100(840)=1320(840)=13(42)=546a=10065​(840)=2013​(840)=13(42)=546​.
Practice
A tank holds 1600 litres of brine, and 3.5%3.5% of it is salt. Enter the number of litres of salt.
Show the solution
a=3.5100(1600)=0.035(1600)=56a=1003.5​(1600)=0.035(1600)=56​.
Practice
A polling office mails out 700 survey forms, and 189 of them come back. Enter what percent of the forms came back, just the number.
Show the solution
Let pp be the percent, so 189=p100(700)189=100p​(700). Multiplying both sides by 100100 gives 700p=18900700p=18900, so p=27p=27​. Checking, 2710010027​ of 700700 is 27×7=18927×7=189.
Practice
A shelf holds 640 books, 80 of them reference books. Enter what percent of the books on the shelf are reference books, just the number.
Show the solution
From 80=p100(640)80=100p​(640), multiplying both sides by 100100 gives 640p=8000640p=8000, so p=12.5p=12.5​. A percent need not be a whole number.
Practice
A deposit of 144 dollars is 32%32% of a fee. Enter the fee in dollars.
Show the solution
From 144=32100b144=10032​b, multiplying both sides by 100100 gives 32b=1440032b=14400, so b=450b=450​. Checking, 32100(450)=14410032​(450)=144.
Practice
A club has 78 members who have paid their dues, and that is 26%26% of the membership. Multiplying 7878 by 26%26% gives 20.2820.28, fewer people than have already paid. Enter the number of members in the club.
Show the solution
With bb the number of members, 78=26100b78=10026​b, and multiplying both sides by 100100 gives 26b=780026b=7800, so b=300b=300​. The 20.2820.28 is 26%26% of the part, and a club is never smaller than the number of members who have paid.
Practice
Depot X ships 250 crates and 24%24% of them are fragile. Depot Y ships 380 crates and 15%15% of them are fragile. Enter the number of fragile crates the two depots ship together.
Show the solution
The counts are 24100(250)=6010024​(250)=60 and 15100(380)=5710015​(380)=57, so the total is 60+57=11760+57=117​. The two percents cannot be added, because 24%24% is taken of 250250 crates and 15%15% of 380380 crates, and 39%39% of all 630630 crates would be 245.7245.7.
Practice
A tank has a capacity of 3060 litres, which is 120%120% of a second tank's capacity. Enter the capacity of the second tank in litres.
Show the solution
From 3060=120100b=65b3060=100120​b=56​b, multiplying both sides by 55 gives 6b=153006b=15300, so b=2550b=2550​. A percent above 100100 means the first tank is the larger of the two, so the answer had to be less than 30603060, and 1.2(2550)=30601.2(2550)=3060 checks.
Practice
In a batch of 45000 screws, 0.24%0.24% are out of tolerance. Enter the number of screws out of tolerance.
Show the solution
0.24%=0.24100=0.00240.24%=1000.24​=0.0024, so the count is 0.0024(45000)=1080.0024(45000)=108​. Using 0.240.24 instead gives 1080010800, which is 24%24% of the batch and a hundred times too many.
Practice
In a depot, 15%15% of the vehicles are vans and the rest are trucks, and there are 630 more trucks than vans. Enter the number of vehicles in the depot.
Show the solution
Writing the total as bb, the vans number 15100b10015​b and the trucks 85100b10085​b, so 70100b=63010070​b=630 and b=900b=900​. The check is 135135 vans and 765765 trucks, a gap of 630630.
